title: OnePlus TV (model D00, codename Dubai), Google TV / Android 14, firmware UTT1.240928.001
header:
OnePlus TV (model D00, codename Dubai), Google TV / Android 14, firmware UTT1.240928.001
Live TV app: com.heytap.tv.livetv. Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/oneplus-tv-dubai/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/oneplus-tv-dubai/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Kept on purpose: Google Assistant (com.google.android.katniss), Chromecast
(com.google.android.apps.mediashell) and the streaming apps. Left alone: the factory apps
(com.heytap.optvfactory, com.oneplus.tv.factory) and com.heytap.oprcupgradeservice (remote updates).
With the stock launcher disabled and no other home installed, Home falls back to Settings.
For the launcher's Inputs menu set live_tv_package to com.heytap.tv.livetv in config.xml.
Seen on this unit: Developer options -> "Don't keep activities" was switched on, which makes every
app restart when you leave it. Check it is off.

apps.note: "BrowseHere" web browser (not a system app: can also be uninstalled)
